entities.summary: Christophe Zakhia El-Kassis is a Lebanese Maronite Catholic archbishop and diplomat. He currently serves as the Apostolic Nuncio to the United Arab Emirates and Yemen along with being the Apostolic Delegate to the Arabian Peninsula.
